instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/guih18_ceiling_rcp_seed.dxf. Complete the hard reflected ceiling plan. Draw WALL rectangle (0,0)-(6000,4200). Add GRID lines every 600 mm in both directions, at minimum including vertical x=600,3000,5400 and horizontal y=600,2400,3600. Add eight LIGHT rectangles 600 x 300 centered at (900,1200), (900,3000), (2400,1200), (2400,3000), (3900,1200), (3900,3000), (5100,1200), and (5100,3000). Add DIFFUSER circles radius 180 at (1500,2100), (3000,2100), (4500,2100), and (5400,3600). Add labels RCP LEVEL 2, 8X LED 600x300, 4X DIFFUSER Ø360, and SW1 A/B. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih18_ceiling_rcp_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
